subject: Regional DR SLA carveout for EuroTech pilot
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Michael Stein <michael.stein@eurotech.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Proposal: regional DR SLA for EuroTech pilot

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, EuroTech's pilot requires a stronger multi-region availability commitment than our standard hosted SLA. Attached is a draft carveout that defines a tiered regional DR commitment for the EU pilot:

- Objective RTO: 15 minutes for region-to-region failover (EU regions only)
- Objective RPO: 5 minutes for request/kv state in normal operation
- Redundancy: active-primary in eu-central + warm-standby in eu-west with automated routing
- Exceptions: scheduled maintenance windows, force majeure, and provider network partition (language included)

We included an operational runbook (dr-runbook-eu-region.docx) describing the automated failover steps and canary validation. If this aligns, we can propose a limited carveout in the Master Services Agreement for the pilot period (90 days), with quarterly DR drills and a post-pilot SLA re-evaluation.

Attaching: redwood-eurotech-dr-sla-draft.pdf, dr-runbook-eu-region.docx

Next step: can you confirm the critical RTO/RPO needs (do you need tighter than 15/5?) and whether EU-only coverage is acceptable for the pilot? I want to loop in Logan (SRE) to confirm the runbook and any operational caveats.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Michael Stein <michael.stein@eurotech.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: ops_lead@eurotech.ai; legal@eurotech.ai
Date: 2027-02-07T13:40:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: regional DR SLA for EuroTech pilot

Sergio —

Appreciate the draft. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) RTO/RPO targets: 15/5 is in the right neighborhood. We need to confirm that those targets apply to production traffic routed through EU regions only (no US fallback for the pilot).
2) Failover behavior: during failover we must guarantee connection handoff for in-flight requests where possible. If full handoff isn’t feasible, a clearly documented degradation profile is required.
3) Measuring & evidence: we’ll need a report or test evidence showing successful region-to-region failover under load (ideally from a recent run).
4) Maintenance windows: we can accept limited maintenance carveouts but need a 72-hour advance notice for any maintenance that could impact multi-region redundancy.

Legal asked whether the exception clause can be timeboxed (pilot-only) and whether Redwood will provide incident transcripts for any events that trigger the carveout.

Can you have Logan provide the runbook sanity checks and a recent DR test summary? That’ll help legal and ops accept the pilot language.

Thanks,
Michael Stein
VP, Infrastructure — EuroTech
michael.stein@eurotech.ai

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Michael Stein <michael.stein@eurotech.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-08T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: regional DR SLA for EuroTech pilot

Michael — looping in Logan (SRE) and Lauren (deal owner) to confirm ops commitments and commercial caveats. See answers below; I’ve also pasted the runbook excerpt and attached a concise DR test summary (eurotech-traffic-analysis.csv) for a recent EU failover rehearsal.

- Scope: We can commit EU-only coverage for the pilot period. That means failover and routing will remain inside EU regions (eu-central/eu-west) and traffic will not be routed to US regions unless explicitly requested.
- RTO/RPO details: Our current validated rehearsal shows median RTO ~12 minutes under synthetic load and worst observed backup-case RTO 18 minutes (we capture metrics and incident timelines). We are comfortable signing 15 minutes as an objective with a narrow SLA credit band if exceeded; RPO (primary KV/state) is typically under 5 minutes with our async replication and KV checkpointing.
- In-flight requests & degradation profile: full transparent handoff is not guaranteed for long-running streaming sessions; we provide an explicit degradation matrix (attached in runbook) showing per-call behavior and soft-failure modes.
- Evidence & tests: attached csv contains the rehearsal timeline and failure injection notes. We can schedule a jointly witnessed DR rehearsal prior to pilot start and provide the incident transcript within 3 business days of any production failover that triggers the carveout.
- Maintenance: we can commit to 72-hour notice for any maints that impact multi-region redundancy and to avoid maints during agreed high-traffic windows.

Operational caveats: during a region partition we may need to temporarily scale down throughput or route to a compatible model variant to preserve correctness. That’s included in the exception clause.

Logan — can you confirm there are no additional infrastructure blockers for the EU-only posture and if quarterly tabletop + one live failover per year is acceptable?

Regards,
Sergio

Subject: Re: Proposal: regional DR SLA for EuroTech pilot

Michael —

Thanks for the detail and for flagging legal/ops asks. We’re prepared to include a timeboxed carveout for the 90-day pilot with the following commercial notes:

- Pricing: regional DR carveout carries a pilot uplift of 12% on hosted consumption during the pilot (reflects reserved warm-standby footprint and runbook validation).
- Credits: SLA credit model: partial credit for minor exceedances; full credit only for systemic misses tied to root-cause analysis.
- Evidence & governance: Redwood will provide the requested rehearsal report and make SRE available for a joint run prior to go-live. Any post-incident transcripts will be supplied within 3 business days.
- Sign-off: If the operational caveats above are acceptable, we’ll issue a time-limited MOU and route it via DocuSign (link below) for signature.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/req/abc123-eurotech-sla
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/EUT-2027-0421

I’ve attached the redwood-eurotech-dr-sla-draft.pdf and a short MOU for signature. If you confirm, we’ll schedule the witness drill for the week of Feb 21.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
